explanation: Compared against OEIS A069191, Sun's second claim: for n ≥ 24 the eigenvalues can be ordered so that λ(1) > -λ(2) > λ(3) > … > (-1)^{n-1}λ(n) > 0. OEIS writes the last term as (-1)^n λ(n), a typo given the pattern. The statement asks for real ev with charpoly = ∏(X - ev i), with (-1)^i·ev i strictly decreasing and positive (0-indexed). That is exactly the alternating pattern; real eigenvalues exist because M is symmetric. Faithful.
